label.purpose: Scores, status, metadata, and action hints.

motion.name: page-enter
motion.purpose: Reveal page content without delaying visibility.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-priority action in ink on paper.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #000; color: #fff; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; font: 500 11px var(--font-albert-sans), sans-serif; transition: background .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #262626; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #000; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ruled Task Row
components.description: Full-width skill choice with one selected ink row.
components.css: .ds-task-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 16px; width: 100%; min-height: 96px; padding: 20px; text-align: left; color: #000; background: #fff; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #e4e4e7; font: 400 12px var(--font-albert-sans), sans-serif; } .ds-task-row:hover { background: #f4f4f5; } .ds-task-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #000; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Active Task Row
components.description: Primary skill row with maximum action contrast.
components.css: .ds-task-row-active { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 16px; width: 100%; min-height: 112px; padding: 20px; text-align: left; color: #fff; background: #000; border: 0; font: 400 12px var(--font-albert-sans), sans-serif; } .ds-task-row-active:hover { background: #262626; } .ds-task-row-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview:
ielts with rbs uses a focused working surface for learners who want to begin practice without navigating a noisy dashboard. The homepage uses paper-white space, black ink, ruled divisions, condensed display type, and quiet monospaced measurements. Structure carries emphasis; decoration stays out of the way.

The visual system is restrained and high-contrast. Full-width practice rows create the main action surface, while progress and review remain supporting evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Condensed headings with readable sans and mono data

rules.name: The Ink-and-Paper Rule
rules.body: Let black ink identify action and paper preserve reading calm; do not add competing accent colors without a product reason.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Use condensed type for hierarchy, sans for explanation, and mono only where data or system state is present.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: No shadow should compete with a practice action; use a border or tonal state first.

dos: Do lead homepage with practice selection, not analytics.
Do use proximity and horizontal rules to group tasks.
Do keep scores and status in JetBrains Mono.
Do preserve visible focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep mobile order identical to desktop reading order.
donts: Don't turn every homepage region into a rounded card.
Don't use decorative gradients, gamified progress treatments, or competing accent colors.
Don't use monospace as the display voice for explanatory copy.
Don't hide empty score states behind an ambiguous dash.
